summaries.summary: A China Fact Sheet from Stark Tourism Forum lists key facts about the People's Republic of China, including its official name, capital, area, population, literacy rate, GDP per capita, major languages, currency, and time zone. The major languages section lists several dialects and languages spoken in the country.
key_facts: Official Name: People's Republic of China (PRC)
Major Languages: Mandarin, Yue (Cantonese), Wu (Shanghainese), Minbei (Fuzhou), Minnan (Hokkien-Taiwanese), Xiang, Gan, Hakka dialects
